properties.name: vadmin.jdbc.enabled
properties.description: Enable JDBC IAM identity, audit, administration storage and initial administrator bootstrap on a host-migrated schema.

properties.name: vadmin.jdbc.table-prefix
properties.description: SQL identifier prefix shared by all six JDBC IAM tables.

properties.name: vadmin.jdbc.uuid-storage
properties.description: STRING binds MySQL CHAR(36) identifiers; NATIVE binds PostgreSQL UUIDs and JSONB audit metadata.

properties.name: vadmin.bootstrap.password
properties.description: Initial admin password on an empty JDBC IAM schema. Falls back to APP_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD; never resets an existing account.
